name: Eshak
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Eshak was a descendant of King Saul through the tribe of Benjamin. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the son of Elah and father to several sons who were skilled warriors and archers. His lineage is part of the genealogical records for the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Eshak's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eshak is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin as the son of Elah, a descendant of King Saul.

keyEvents.title: Eshak's Sons
keyEvents.description: Eshak's sons are listed: Ulam, the firstborn; Jeush, the second; and Eliphelet, the third.

keyEvents.title: Ulam's Descendants as Archers
keyEvents.description: Ulam's sons, the grandsons of Eshek, were skilled warriors and archers. They had many sons and grandsons, a total of 150 men.

keyEvents.title: Part of Benjamin's Tribal Register
keyEvents.description: Eshek's family is part of the extensive register of the tribe of Benjamin, kept to preserve the genealogical history of Israel's tribes.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Saul's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Through his ancestor Eleakim, Eshek belonged to the royal lineage of Saul, Israel's first king, although the family no longer held royal power.
